Step 3. Consider the Hilbert-Schmidt operator \(W_{01270013}\) acting on the topological space. By the Hilbert-Schmidt decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|W_{01270013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01270013\).

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through Laplace approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
